metrics.preferred_job_title: Customer Relationship Management / Digital Operations Specialist
metrics.profile_summary: Professional with 3+ years of experience in high-volume E-commerce customer service and claims resolution. Combines expertise in B2B/B2C relationship management with technical skills in front-end development and digital marketing.

education.institution: Dadabhoy Institute of Higher Education, Karachi
education.degree: Bachelor of Science in Computer Science (BSCS)

experience.description: Processes high-volume customer orders and complex return/cancellation requests while consistently meeting service targets.
Resolved 999+ complex seller claims, adhered to SLAs, mentored 10+ new staff, and mitigated critical customer behavioral risks.
Managed E-commerce interactions and complaints while handling social media engagement on Facebook and Instagram.
Provided E-commerce customer support via WhatsApp and calls, focusing on first-contact resolution.
Contributed to the design, development, and maintenance of various website projects.
